body: [A10] Correction and completion of the earlier entry. Until the re-key, worker 1/26 projects about 1,377 s with `gptp_shadow` at its composed ~520 s: about 101 s over 1,276 s on one worker. Hosted run 45550366428 measured 1,373 s. The steps are: (1) re-key `gptp_shadow` from the merged head's first two complete hosted runs; (2) re-deal until every regular worker projects at most 1,276 s; (3) record the figure's derivation with the other #998 figures. Decision: PR #1003's comments (corrected).
